Note for the site build: add the practice phone number and the client portal or scheduling link here, and connect a HIPAA-appropriate intake form. Plain web forms should not collect clinical detail.

What to include

  • Whether you want therapy, LPC supervision or EMDR consultation.
  • Online or in person, and roughly where in Texas you are.
  • Two or three windows of time that usually work for you.
  • For supervision: your CV or resume, three professional references, and your answers to the application questions.

If this is urgent

This practice does not provide emergency care. Call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or 911 if you are in immediate danger.

Reem Glasco is a Licensed Professional Counselor Supervisor in Texas, licence 66562. Complaints about a Texas licensee go to the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council, 1-800-821-3205. Nothing on this site is therapy, supervision, or a substitute for either. If you are in crisis, call or text 988.
